title: Cinema captioned matinee
brief:
Write a public notice for patrons of the independent Kite House Cinema about its first open-captioned matinee. The screening is of the fictional film The Orchard Clock on February 14 at 2 p.m. Captions appear on the main screen and display dialogue and relevant sounds. Seats are $6 and can be bought at the box office from noon on the day. The screening is open to everyone, and seats are first come, first served. The lobby opens at 1:15 p.m. The notice will go in the front window and on the printed monthly calendar.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

3a109d3d0ca9c857.text:
**Kite House Cinema’s First Open-Captioned Matinee**  
*The Orchard Clock*  
**February 14 at 2 p.m.**

Everyone is welcome at this screening. Open captions appear on the main screen throughout the film, so everyone in the audience can read the dialogue and descriptions of relevant sounds.

Seats are $6 and are available first come, first served. You can buy tickets at the box office starting at noon on February 14. The lobby opens at 1:15 p.m.

1722e6e57291d46e.text:
## Kite House Cinema’s First Open-Captioned Matinee

**The Orchard Clock**  
**February 14 at 2 p.m.**

Join us for our first open-captioned matinee at Kite House Cinema. Captions will appear on the main screen throughout the film, displaying dialogue and relevant sounds. Everyone is welcome.

Seats are $6 and are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Tickets go on sale at the box office at noon on the day of the screening. The lobby opens at 1:15 p.m.
